updates.prompt: For a single leased point-to-point WAN circuit connecting two sites, which two characteristics apply? (Choose two.)
updates.explanation: A、E。题设是运营商提供给两端站点的单条专用点到点逻辑电路；线路连接两端网络，并可在运营商共享物理基础设施上实现，带宽和服务保障由具体合同规定。单条链路本身不能提供路径冗余；多路由器之间每对均有直连是全网状拓扑。点对点并不要求两个终端必然是路由器，也不必保证物理层独占。

updates.prompt: Which two architectural features characterize a logically centralized, controller-based network? (Choose two.)

options.label: A
options.text: It uses Telnet as the required system-event reporting protocol.

options.label: B
options.text: All configuration changes must be made only through each device CLI.

options.label: C
options.text: It uses northbound and southbound APIs to communicate between architectural layers.

options.label: D
options.text: It decentralizes the control plane, which allows each device to make its own forwarding decisions.

options.label: E
options.text: It moves the control plane to a central point.

updates.explanation: C、E。控制器架构提供逻辑集中的网络控制视图，北向接口面向应用，南向接口连接设备与基础设施。控制器可由多台节点组成，设备仍可保留本地控制功能；并不代表所有功能物理集中或设备只能转发。CLI 有时仍可用于管理，但逐设备 CLI 不是唯一管理方式；Telnet 不是事件报告的必需协议。

updates.prompt: For a classic Cisco STP access port configured with PortFast and connected to an end host, which two statements best describe its behavior? (Choose two.)
updates.explanation: C、D。PortFast 在链路上线时跳过通常的 listening 和 learning 等待，快速进入 forwarding；连接主机时不需要收到来自主机的 BPDU 才能转发。PortFast 不等于 BPDU filter：端口仍可能发送或接收 BPDU；若配置 BPDU Guard，收到 BPDU 会触发保护，具体行为依 STP 模式和配置而异。它不是上行链路冗余收敛或 BackboneFast 的替代。
